articles.title: 'Suspicious' Polymarket accounts net $340K on well-timed trades upon Jensen Huang's return
articles.summary: Someone made $340K on Polymarket betting that Jensen Huang would return to Nvidia, timing their bets suspiciously well and triggering insider-trading allegations. If prediction markets can't police information asymmetries, regulators will do it for them, and that's how you get the whole operation shut down.

articles.title: Kalshi Faces Threat of Nationwide Shutdown in New York Case
articles.summary: Kalshi, one of the few legal prediction markets in the US, is fighting a potential nationwide shutdown after a case in New York. If regulators win, it could effectively kill the only accessible way Americans can legally bet on real-world events at scale.

articles.title: Polymarket, Kalshi didn’t outperform mainstream forecasts in midterms: Report
articles.summary: Polymarket and Kalshi, two major prediction markets that gained mainstream attention, didn't actually beat traditional polling and forecasts during the 2016 midterms. The finding undermines the core pitch that real-money skin-in-the-game produces superior predictions compared to aggregated expert opinion.

articles.title: New York judge urged Kalshi to compromise on limiting bets by anyone under 21
articles.summary: A New York judge pushed Kalshi, the CFTC-approved prediction market platform, to restrict betting access for anyone under 21 instead of fighting the age requirement outright. The move signals regulators are willing to negotiate on market access rules, which could reshape how prediction markets balance growth against compliance pressures.

articles.title: Kalshi pauses operations in Utah after adverse federal court ruling
articles.summary: Kalshi, one of the few legal prediction markets in the US, hit pause on Utah operations following a federal court decision that went against the platform. The ruling signals that regulators and courts still view prediction markets as gambling rather than legitimate forecasting tools, which is bad news for anyone betting the industry's legal status improves anytime soon.

articles.title: Prediction Market Rule From CFTC Under White House Review
articles.summary: The CFTC just proposed new rules for prediction markets and the White House is currently reviewing whether to greenlight them. If approved, this could either unlock the market's potential or strangle it depending on how restrictive the final language turns out to be.

articles.title: Democrats put campus gambling in the crosshairs
articles.summary: Democrats are moving to restrict or ban gambling operations on college campuses, targeting everything from sportsbooks to daily fantasy sports apps marketed to students. This matters because regulatory crackdowns on campus betting could reshape the entire college sports betting ecosystem and potentially crater some operators' growth projections if restrictions gain real traction.

articles.title: New York lawmaker proposes bill to regulate and tax prediction markets
articles.summary: A New York lawmaker wants to slap regulation and taxes on prediction markets, the latest attempt by legislators to bring America's fastest-growing betting category under government control. If it passes, expect the playbook to spread to other states like a bad rash, potentially killing the margins that make these platforms worth running in the first place.

articles.title: Most winnings on Polymarket midterm bets went to top 1% of bettors, report says
articles.summary: The top 1% of Polymarket bettors captured the majority of winnings from the 2022 midterm elections, suggesting prediction markets concentrate wealth among sophisticated traders rather than distributing it evenly. This matters because it raises questions about whether Polymarket actually functions as a diverse information-aggregation engine or just another casino rigged for professionals.

articles.title: How Luana Lopes Lara built Kalshi into a $40 billion prediction market giant that overtook Polymarket
articles.summary: Luana Lopes Lara scaled Kalshi from obscurity to a $40B valuation and market dominance over the previously untouchable Polymarket, proving that founder execution and regulatory navigation beat first-mover advantage in prediction markets. If Kalshi can dethrone the category leader, it signals that the prediction market wars are still wide open and retail adoption is reaching escape velocity.

articles.title: Meta AI Chief Alexandr Wang Says ‘Superintelligence Is Arriving’ — Prediction Market Bets on the Date
articles.summary: Meta's AI chief is making the bold claim that superintelligence is on the horizon, and prediction market bettors are already lining up to wager on when it actually arrives. The timeline question matters because it's worth real money, and Wang's credibility as an AI insider just moved the needle on when the smart money thinks we're actually getting there.

articles.title: Kalshi Warns New York Lawsuit Could Force It to Shut Down Across the U.S.
articles.summary: Kalshi is facing a New York lawsuit that could shut down the prediction market platform nationwide, threatening its entire U.S. operations. If the platform gets taken offline, it's one less venue for retail traders to speculate on elections, sports, and economic outcomes, though the core question of whether prediction markets are legal in the U.S. will likely end up in a bigger fight anyway.
